input.body:
Hello Leo,

Regarding your request to have the same access as Priya Nair while she is on leave, we have granted you the following access groups:
- SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE (Confluence finance space)
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ (Finance Reports readers)
- SYN-GRP-JIRA-WRITE (Jira editors)

There are two additional groups you need, SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors) and SYN-GRP-PAYROLL-ADMIN (Payroll administrators), which require your manager's approval before granting. These requests are noted and pending operator review and approval.

We will update you once these are approved or if any further action is needed.

Thank you for your patience.
